# Cancellation Policy

Status: Approved
Decision date: 2026-08-10

A standard booking may be cancelled without a fee until 24 hours before its scheduled start.

Voucher-funded bookings are exempt from the late-cancellation fee even inside the cutoff.

Late standard cancellations incur a $10 fee. This policy records the amount but not the rationale for it.

## Future Idea

Proposal dated 2026-09-01: consider granting a service credit after a provider cancels. This proposal has
not been approved or implemented.
